highLevelGoal: Make Orca crash-safe at its core unattended-execution boundaries: durable repository actor/process ownership across controller death, no second writer under live/unknown prior ownership, atomic/replayable dispatch-control-completion transitions, and bounded initialization/profile cleanup.
